AnalogClock.name: AnalogClock
AnalogClock.doc:
AnalogClock is a container that represents a traditional clock with
        rotating hands.

Animation.name: Animation
Animation.doc:
Animation for parent element.
        Use "ANIMATION_VALUE" from the parent element's arithmetic attribute.

attributes.name: interpolation
attributes.doc: Interpolation method. Default is linear.

attributes.name: repeat
attributes.doc:
Sets how many times the animation should be repeated. If the repeat
            count is 0, the animation is never repeated. If the repeat count is
            -1 then the animation will loop indefinitely.
            The repeat count is 0 by default.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.doc: Duration in seconds

Arc.name: Arc
Arc.doc:
Draw arc line with given bound. Center point of arc is the center of the bounds.
        Angle is given in degrees with 0 indicating 12 o'clock.

Condition.name: Condition
Condition.doc:
The Condition element provides the ability to provide a list of options - Compare
        Elements - each of which is evaluated against an expression, in turn. Only the first
        successful Compare element is selected, the others are not rendered or enabled.
        If none of the Compare elements evaluate successfully, the Default Element is shown.

attributes.name: id
attributes.doc:
Identifier of the configuration. It must be the ID that is present in a
                      configuration within UserConfiguration tag.

attributes.name: optionId
attributes.doc:
Identifier of the option. It must be one of the options present in the
                      configuration specified as id.

attributes.name: screenReaderText
attributes.doc:
Description text to be read by screen reader for accessibility. It is
                      recommended to use string resource id for localization.

Default.name: Default
Default.doc: The Default element is enabled when no Compare element evaluates successfully.

DigitalClock.name: DigitalClock
DigitalClock.doc: DigitalClock is a container for text-based formatted time.

Ellipse.name: Ellipse
Ellipse.doc: Draw (fill or stroke) ellipse shape with given bound.

Fill.name: Fill
Fill.doc:
Element with an attribute about fill color. It supports gradient colors with a child element,
        LinearGradient, RadialGradient or SweepGradient. If more than one gradient is added, the
        gradient added at the last is only valid.

attributes.name: id
attributes.doc:
Identifier of the configuration. It must be the ID that is present in a
                      configuration within UserConfiguration tag.

attributes.name: optionId
attributes.doc:
Identifier of the option. It must be one of the options present in the
                      configuration specified as id.

attributes.name: screenReaderText
attributes.doc:
Description text to be read by screen reader for accessibility. It is
                      recommended to use string resource id for localization.

attributes.name: slotId
attributes.doc:
Identifier of the complication slot. It must be one of the ComplicationSlots
                      present in the Scene tag.

Group.name: Group
Group.doc:
The Group element contains other groups or parts as children.
        This is an important node in the scene graph that lays out the components on the scene.
        The group does not have the ability to draw on its own, but it affects the position, size,
        angle or color of the child hierarchies.

attributes.name: name
attributes.doc: Name of this group.

Gyro.name: Gyro
Gyro.doc:
The Gyro element adjusts some attributes of the parent Group or Part according to an expression
        using gyro sensor data source.
        ex. x="(5/90)* clamp([ACCELEROMETER_ANGLE_X], 0, 90) + (-5/-90)* clamp([ACCELEROMETER_ANGLE_X], -90, 0)"

HourHand.name: HourHand
HourHand.doc: A image that represents an hour hand, it rotates 360 degree in 12 hours.

HsbFilter.name: HsbFilter
HsbFilter.doc: A filter that adjusts pixels by hue, saturate or brightness

attributes.name: resource
attributes.doc:
Drawable id of image resource
            or
            Source of image. e.g., Some complications could have a source of image such as ICON,
            SMALL_IMAGE or LARGE_IMAGE.

ImageFilters.name: ImageFilters
ImageFilters.doc: ImageFilters is a container for filters that affect the pixels in the bitmap.

Images.name: Images
Images.doc:
Images is a container that has a series of image resources.
        Only one image is shown at a time, and is changed using by tap.

Line.name: Line
Line.doc: Draw line from start point to end point

LinearGradient.name: LinearGradient
LinearGradient.doc: Set a gradient color consisting of a progressive transition between two or more colors along a straight line

Localization.name: Localization
Localization.doc:
The Localization is used to fix the date or time to a specific locale or timezone when
        a parent node such as a part or group has an action related to the date or time.

attributes.name: timeZone
attributes.doc:
timezone
          e.g., "Asia/Seoul" or "Europe/London"

attributes.name: locales
key
attributes.doc: Any unique key

attributes.name: value
attributes.doc: Any value

MinuteHand.name: MinuteHand
MinuteHand.doc: A image that represent a minute hand, it rotates 360 degree in 1 hour.

PartDraw.name: PartDraw
PartDraw.doc: PartDraw is element that draws primitive types of figure like line, rect, arc, circle and rounded rectangle.

attributes.name: source
attributes.doc: Source of image. This can only be pointed to a PhotosConfiguration.

attributes.name: defaultImageResource
attributes.doc: Resource for default image.

attributes.name: change
attributes.doc: Event trigger for changing photos.

attributes.name: changeAfterEvery
attributes.doc:
Number of times of the change event before the actual change takes place.
                        Only works with ON_VISIBLE.

attributes.name: width
attributes.doc:
Size of the crop in pixels (width, height), if any of these are zero,
                        the original crop (device width, device height) is retained.

attributes.name: height
attributes.doc:
Size of the crop in pixels (width, height), if any of these are zero,
                        the original crop (device width, device height) is retained.

attributes.name: id
attributes.doc: Identifier of the configuration, this must be an unique value.

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.doc:
Title of the configuration. This text will be shown in the configuration activity. It is
                recommended to use string resource id for localization.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.doc:
Icon of the configuration, this will be used as an item of option list in the
                  configuration activity.

attributes.name: screenReaderText
attributes.doc:
Description text to be read by screen reader for accessibility. It is recommended to use
                  string resource id for localization.

attributes.name: highlight
attributes.doc:
Highlight image indicating where this configuration changes. Since it will be laid on the
                watch face preview, some restrictions should be considered:
                1. Background MUST be transparent.
                2. It SHOULD be tint-able.
                3. The content SHOULD show the boundary of a part where will be changed by user style
                selection.

attributes.name: configType
attributes.doc: How the user will select the images on companion (SINGLE, MULTIPLE)

RadialGradient.name: RadialGradient
RadialGradient.doc: Set a gradient color consisting of a progressive transition between two or more colors that radiate from an origin

Rectangle.name: Rectangle
Rectangle.doc: Draw (fill or stroke) rectangle shape with given bound.

Reference.name: Reference
Reference.doc:
Reference is a new element which can be placed under any scene object supporting Transform.
        Reference allows you to publish Transformable attributes from a source element,
        which can be consumed as a DataSource in other expressions within your Scene.
        The element has three attributes: name, source attribute's name and default value.

        "Reference" can be referenced in o

RoundRectangle.name: RoundRectangle
RoundRectangle.doc: Draw (fill or stroke) rectangle shape that has rounded corners with given bounds.

Scene.name: Scene
Scene.doc: Scene is a container of Visual tags. A watch face MUST include at least one Scene.

attributes.name: backgroundColor
attributes.doc:
The color of the scene's background.
            Default value is #ff000000 (Black).

ScreenReader.name: ScreenReader
ScreenReader.doc:
The user may turn on the talkback screen reader to interact with the watch face
        with touch and voice feedback. ScreenReader can be attached to any group or
        part to let user know how they work.

SecondHand.name: SecondHand
SecondHand.doc: A image that represents a second hand, it rotates 360 degree in 1 minute.

attributes.name: frameRate
attributes.doc:
This allows users to set the speed at which frames included in the SequenceImages should
            be played. For example, if the frameRate of SequenceImages with 30 images is set to 15,
            it is animated to show 30 frames in 2 seconds. If the frameRate is set to 30, 30 frames
            are played during 1 second.
            This specifies the play speed of the content, and it doesn'

Stroke.name: Stroke
Stroke.doc:
Element with attributes for a stroke style. It supports gradient colors with a child element,
        LinearGradient, RadialGradient or SweepGradient. If more than one gradient is added, the
        gradient added at the last is only valid.

attributes.name: join
attributes.doc: The Join specifies the treatment where lines and curve segments join on a stroked path. The default is MITER.

Sweep.name: Sweep
Sweep.doc:
Definition of second hand movement.
      The angle of the second hand will be updated by the given frequency for one second.

      SYNC_TO_DEVICE means that the angle is updated smoothly as allowed by the device. (Since V2)

SweepGradient.name: SweepGradient
SweepGradient.doc:
Set a gradient color consisting of a progressive transition between two or more colors that
        sweep an angle from startAngle to endAngle

Text.name: Text
Text.doc: Specifies Plain Text configuration for any text

attributes.name: lineSpacing
attributes.doc:
Negative spacing is supported, but Restricts the minimum lineSpacing value to -5 to
            prevent excessive text clipping or inverted rendering issues
            that may occur with large negative line spacing values

attributes.name: isAutoSize
attributes.doc:
Whether text auto scale.
            The min size is 12px and the size will be reduced to prevent the text from overflowing.
            If used with ellipsis, First, text auto scale is applied.
            Afterwards, if text is exceeded, ellipsis is applied.

Tick.name: Tick
Tick.doc:
Definition of second hand movement. It has 2 attributes below.

        Strength means intensity that exceeded the final value.
        0.5 : has 125% peek value of the final value.
        1.0 : has 200% peek value of the final value.

        Duration means how long the animation is interpolated.
        0.2 :   0 ~ 200 (ms) - interpolated value by given strength and time
              200 ~ 800

TimeText.name: TimeText
TimeText.doc: TimeText renders the time within the DigitalClock container.

UserConfigurations.name: UserConfigurations
UserConfigurations.doc:
UserConfigurations is a set of Configuration to support various appearance options.
        These can be used for Colors, Type of Hands, Background, Complication etc.

attributes.name: id
attributes.doc: Identifier of the option, it should be an unique value.

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.doc:
Name of the option.This text will be shown in the configuration activity.
                            It is recommended to use string resource id for localization.

attributes.name: screenReaderText
attributes.doc:
Description text to be read by screen reader for accessibility. It is
                            recommended to use string resource id for localization.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.doc:
Icon of the option, this drawable will be shown in the configuration
                            activity.

attributes.name: childSettingIds
attributes.doc:
A list of child user style settings that can be edited only when the
                            current ListOption is selected.

attributes.name: complicationSlotIds
attributes.doc:
A list of complication slot IDs that are enabled and visible only when
                            the current ListOption is selected. Complication Slots that are not
                            referenced by any ListOption are always enabled.

attributes.name: colors
attributes.doc: List of color values

attributes.name: highlight
attributes.doc:
Highlight image indicating where this configuration changes. Since it will be laid on the
                watch face preview, some restrictions should be considered:
                1. Background MUST be transparent.
                2. It SHOULD be tint-able.
                3. The content SHOULD show the boundary of a part where will be changed by user style
                selection.

attributes.name: configType
attributes.doc: How the user will select the images on companion (SINGLE, MULTIPLE)

attributes.name: duration
attributes.doc:
Normalized duration value to [0.0, 1.0]
            The duration is the effect time when switching between the interactive and ambient mode.
            It is dependent on each vendor's ambient transition time.
            The actual effect duration is determined as a normalized value, scaled proportionally based on the ambient transition time set by the vendor.

attributes.name: startOffset
attributes.doc:
Normalized delay value to [0.0, 1.0]
            If the sum of duration and startOffset is greater than 1.0, startOffset will be ignored.

attributes.name: interpolation
attributes.doc: Interpolation method. Default is linear.

attributes.name: controls
attributes.doc: controls attribute is meaningful only when interpolation type is CUBIC_BEZIER.

attributes.name: angleDirection
attributes.doc:
The direction of animation while an element rotates.
            It doesn't change the the final value of the animation.
            It is affected only when the target is an angle.

WatchFace.name: WatchFace
WatchFace.doc:
WatchFace is a root element of watchface.xml. It contains scheme version of the xml
        specification and the information of the virtual screen used when the sub-elements are
        created.

attributes.name: width
attributes.doc:
Size of the visual screen in which watch face components are drawn. It is not related to
            the display resolution of the real device, and all figures related to geometry(position
            and dimension) among the attributes of the child elements indicate the relative position
            and size in the virtual screen.

attributes.name: height
attributes.doc:
Size of the visual screen in which watch face components are drawn. It is not related to
            the display resolution of the real device, and all figures related to geometry(position
            and dimension) among the attributes of the child elements indicate the relative position
            and size in the virtual screen.

attributes.name: clipShape
attributes.doc:
Creators can require a shape that clips the result. This can be useful, for example, when
            creators want to produce a circular result on a rectangular device. In some cases, there
            may be objects that span outside the desired shape.
            RECTANGLE shape with cornerRadiusX and cornerRadiusY attributes makes round-rectangle.
            Default value is CIRCLE.

attributes.name: cornerRadiusX
attributes.doc:
The x-radius of the rounded corners on the rectangle.
            It is available when the shape type is RECTANGLE.

attributes.name: cornerRadiusY
attributes.doc:
The y-radius of the rounded corners on the rectangle.
            It is available when the shape type is RECTANGLE.

WeightedStroke.name: WeightedStroke
WeightedStroke.doc: Stroke style with weight, each element can have different colors.

attributes.name: colors
attributes.doc: Series of color in hexadecimal like "#FF0000 #00FF00 #0000FF".

attributes.name: weights
attributes.doc:
Series of weight in float like "3.0 4.0 5.0". Each value represents a
                        portion of the stroke range.

attributes.name: discreteGap
attributes.doc:
This indicates the gap between elements. It is useful when the strokes
                        split by weight are clearly divided, especially when there is a round cap.
                        This is because each cap of the divided stroke overlaps each other as they
                        are placed outside the stroke. To prevent overlapping caps, this value can
                        be set t

attributes.name: interpolate
attributes.doc:
If it is true, the stroke is drawn as a gradient color. Each segment takes
                        two colors for gradation: from and to. It means that the number of colors should
                        be one more than the number of weights. For example, two weights requires
                        three colors to show a color gradient across all segments of the stroke.

attributes.name: thickness
attributes.doc: Width of stroke. Center of thickness is given arc geometry.

attributes.name: cap
attributes.doc: The Cap specifies the treatment for the beginning and ending of stroked lines and paths.

attributes.name: join
attributes.doc: The Join specifies the treatment where lines and curve segments join on a stroked path. The default is MITER.
